ethical_question: A clinic has one dose of antiviral. Dr. Rivera must give the antiviral to either one child or three adult patients, but not both. If Dr. Rivera gives the antiviral to the child, the child has an 80% chance of survival. If Dr. Rivera gives the antiviral to the three adult patients, each of the three adult patients has a 60% chance of survival. The patients who do not receive the antiviral will die.
